Owners: SM Ensley Property LLC; and Saundra Borie, Trustee, Saundra Borie Trust
Case No. CHC-2025-6217-HCM

Fiscal Impact Statement:
No

Yes

TIME LIMIT FILE - SEPTEMBER 6, 2026
(LAST DAY FOR COUNCIL ACTION - SEPTEMBER 4, 2026)
summary: Designation of Fox Apartments as Historic-Cultural Monuments.
